todo: Scripts need review by someone with lived-experience input. Deliberately substance-agnostic: no line names a substance, so the same line works whatever is being offered and nothing here reads as a description of a drug.
ladderLabels: They push again — this is your exit

contexts.label: A friend you trust
contexts.blurb: Not a stranger. Someone whose opinion of you actually matters.

light: I'm good — but pass it on, don't waste it on me.
Ha, still good. You can stop checking.
I'm gonna go get a drink. Come find me after.
flat: Still no. It's not a mood thing.
I'm gonna head off. Text me tomorrow.
firm: No. I'd rather you didn't offer me that.
I've said no. I don't want to say it a third time.
I'm going to go. This doesn't change anything between us, but I'm going.

contexts.label: Nightlife
contexts.blurb: A club, a bar, someone's place after.

light: I'm good, seriously.
Still good. Ask me again next year.
I'm gonna go find water. Catch you later.
firm: Not for me. Don't offer again.
I've told you once. Drop it.
I'm leaving. This isn't a discussion.

contexts.label: NS bunk
contexts.blurb: You can't leave, and you'll see these people tomorrow.

light: Nah, I've got enough problems already.
Still got those problems. Still passing.
I'm gonna go take a walk. Back later.
flat: I'm going back to my bunk.
firm: No. And keep it away from me.
I already said no. That's the last time.
Don't involve me in this. I'm going.

contexts.label: Hall or uni
contexts.blurb: Your room is thirty seconds away, which is your advantage.

light: I'm out — got a 9am.
Still out. The 9am hasn't moved.
Right, I'm heading up. Night.
flat: I'm going back to my room.
firm: No. I don't want to be asked again.
That's twice. Stop.
I'm leaving now.

contexts.label: Overseas trip
contexts.blurb: Different rules, same you. Getting home matters more than the night.

light: Nah, I'm the boring one this trip.
Still boring. Proudly.
I'm heading back to the hotel — you go on.
flat: No, I'm not doing that here.
I'll see you tomorrow. I'm going back.
firm: No. Not here, not anywhere.
I've said no twice now.
I'm getting my own way back. Don't follow me.

contexts.label: Workplace
contexts.blurb: Where saying no has to survive Monday morning.

light: I'll pass — but get me a coffee?
Still passing. Coffee offer stands.
I'm gonna head back to my desk.
flat: I'm heading off — early start tomorrow.
firm: No. Please don't ask me at work.
I've asked you to drop it.
If this comes up again I'll take it further.

contexts.label: Family gathering
contexts.blurb: The hardest room to leave, and the one you can't stop being in.

light: Aiyah, not for me lah.
Still not for me. Don't waste it.
I'm gonna go help in the kitchen.
flat: I'm still going to say no.
I'm stepping out for some air.
firm: No. I'd rather not explain why.
I've said no. Please respect that.
I'm going to head off. I'll call you tomorrow.

contexts.label: Exam crunch
contexts.blurb: When someone offers you a shortcut and you're tired enough to consider it.

light: Nah, I'd rather just be tired.
Still rather be tired. It's going great.
I'm gonna go sleep for real. Night.
firm: No. I'm not putting my exams on it.
I've said no. Don't offer again.
I'm leaving the library. See you after.
